Accessibility & Inclusive Design: Build a Web Everyone Can Enter

Inclusive web application design provides equitable system interactions for individuals experiencing varied situational or long-term operational challenges.


Visual Impairments

Requires structured semantic HTML elements, high default text color contrast ratios, and descriptive aria tags for screen reader text translation output engines.

Auditory Impairments

Requires descriptive synchronous caption integrations, complete written structural transcript mapping for multi-media visual or video tracks, and visual notification confirmations.

Keyboard Navigation

Requires total structural interface control using keyboard inputs exclusively (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space). Forbids input traps and mandates prominent focus indicator rings.

Cognitive Impairments

Demands logical layout organization configurations, predictable content navigation behaviors, clear plain language structure definitions, and minimal flashing visual distractions.
